triggers.name: trg_address_components_after_update

CREATE   DEFINER=`root`@`localhost`   TRIGGER `trg_address_components_after_update` AFTER UPDATE ON `tbd_address_components` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
    INSERT INTO `tb_logs` (
        `table_name`,
        `operation`,
        `db_users`,
        `description`,
        `operation_date`,
        `operation_status`
    ) VALUES (
        'tb_address_components',
        'Update',
        USER(),
        CONCAT(
            'Componente actualizado. ID=', NEW.ID,
            '. Cambios: ',
            CONCAT_WS(
                ', ',
                IF(
                    NOT (OLD.address_ID <=> NEW.address_ID),
                    CONCAT('address_ID: [', OLD.address_ID, '] -> [', NEW.address_ID, ']'),
                    NULL
                ),
                IF(
                    NOT (OLD.value <=> NEW.value),
                    CONCAT('value: [', OLD.value, '] -> [', NEW.value, ']'),
                    NULL
                ),
                IF(
                    NOT (OLD.component_type <=> NEW.component_type),
                    CONCAT('component_type: [', OLD.component_type, '] -> [', NEW.component_type, ']'),
                    NULL
                ),
                IF(
                    NOT (OLD.status <=> NEW.status),
                    CONCAT('status: [', OLD.status + 0, '] -> [', NEW.status + 0, ']'),
                    NULL
                ),
                IF(
                    NOT (OLD.address_sup_ID <=> NEW.address_sup_ID),
                    CONCAT(
                        'address_sup_ID: [',
                        COALESCE(CAST(OLD.address_sup_ID AS CHAR), 'NULL'),
                        '] -> [',
                        COALESCE(CAST(NEW.address_sup_ID AS CHAR), 'NULL'),
                        ']'
                    ),
                    NULL
                ),
                IF(
                    NOT (OLD.last_update <=> NEW.last_update),
                    CONCAT(
                        'last_update: [',
                        COALESCE(CAST(OLD.last_update AS CHAR), 'NULL'),
                        '] -> [',
                        COALESCE(CAST(NEW.last_update AS CHAR), 'NULL'),
                        ']'
                    ),
                    NULL
                )
            )
        ),
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        b'1'
    );
END

ID=', NEW.ID, '. Cambios: ', CONCAT_WS( ', ', IF( NOT (OLD.address_ID <=> NEW.address_ID), CONCAT('address_ID: [', OLD.address_ID, '] -> [', NEW.address_ID, ']'), NULL ), IF( NOT (OLD.value <=> NEW.value), CONCAT('value: [', OLD.value, '] -> [', NEW.value, ']'), NULL ), IF( NOT (OLD.component_type <=> NEW.component_type), CONCAT('component_type: [', OLD.component_type, '] -> [', NEW.component_type, ']'), NULL ), IF( NOT (OLD.status <=> NEW.status), CONCAT('status: [', OLD.status + 0, '] -> [', NEW.status + 0, ']'), NULL ), IF( NOT (OLD.address_sup_ID <=> NEW.address_sup_ID), CONCAT( 'address_sup_ID: [', COALESCE(CAST(OLD.address_sup_ID AS CHAR), 'NULL'), '] -> [', COALESCE(CAST(NEW.address_sup_ID AS CHAR), 'NULL'), ']' ), NULL ), IF( NOT (OLD.last_update <=> NEW.last_update), CONCAT( 'last_update: [', COALESCE(CAST(OLD.last_update AS CHAR), 'NULL'), '] -> [', COALESCE(CAST(NEW.last_update AS CHAR), 'NULL'), ']' ), NULL ) ) ), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, b'1' ); END
